analysis.inspected_by: agent (GitHub Copilot) using the reference-analyst workflow
analysis.method: Viewed overview (20 frames over the full 15 s), scene sheet (10 scenes, start/middle/end) and transition strips (every 2nd frame, -10..+10 frames around each of 11 boundaries). Audio judged from measurements only (onsets, tempo, cut/beat alignment); not listened to. Backfill 2026-11-26 (integrator, session D): reference-corpus.py listen run on this host; listen/listen.jpg opened; loudness, accents, accents on cuts against chance, silences and dictation phrases read from automated.listen and checked on the sheet. analysis.coverage: Full duration; every detected boundary inspected at frame level.

concept.observed: A self-promotional reel for a 'motion designer' persona: a series of motion studies (easing chart, shape morphs, tile wave, point cloud, kinetic words) ending on a brand lockup.
concept.interpreted: Demonstrates motion craft by enacting motion vocabulary; reads as a capability showcase.

communication_style.observed: No narration; fast cuts, single words, technical captions in corners.

visual_identity.observed: Near-black, saturated orange-red, ultramarine blue and cream fields; persistent corner frame with micro labels.

palette.observed: Measured top colours #080818 (26%), #f85838 (23%), #f8e8e8 (14%), #2838f8 (8%); 38% of frames dark.
palette.interpreted: Two hot accents on dark and cream give strong figure-ground swaps.

typography.observed: Heavy condensed caps for single words, italic serif for a subtitle, tiny mono labels; accent full stops.

composition.observed: Centred single subjects; full-bleed colour fields; words fill the frame width.

shapes_and_materials.observed: Flat dots, rings, triangles, squares, Truchet-like arcs, dot grids; one 3D point cloud.

motion.observed: Dots travel on arcs with trails; shapes morph with orbiting satellites; tiles rotate in a wave; letters fall and tile.

easing.observed: An on-screen chart compares six ways to move between two points; moves mostly strong ease-in-out with hard stops.

timing_and_rhythm.observed: Measured median shot 1.87 s; word section cuts every 0.23-0.47 s (11.25-13.10 s).
timing_and_rhythm.interpreted: Accelerating structure: studies first, then a burst of words.

transitions.observed: Re-read 2026-11-27: 10 boundaries (7 cut, 1 grow, 2 cover, 0 continuous). 1.88 s grow: a spark shrinks to a dot (1.73-1.86 s), a cream disc bursts from it and an orange disc grows inside it (1.89-2.06 s); the orange is the next background. 3.50 s cover: the name's letters collapse to dots and a cream diagonal edge wipes from the lower left in about 0.05 s (3.48-3.51 s). 5.63 s cut: the background swaps from cream to blue while the dot holds its place (figure and ground swap). 7.50 s cut: blue to black with the white square held. 9.67 s cover: the tile pattern dissolves outward from the centre into a dark dot grid in about 0.25 s (9.54-9.78 s). 11.25 s cut: black to the first word card; the word smears in horizontally. 11.48 s cut: word card; the new word smears in from the right. 11.72 s cut: word card; the word rises in with a vertical smear. 12.18 s cut: word card; letters drop in one after another. 12.65 s cut: word card. Earlier reading (2026-10-30): Point-to-iris bloom with a leading ring (1.88 s), letters collapsing to dots plus a diagonal wipe (3.50 s), figure-ground colour swap on a held dot (5.63 s), held square over a background change (7.50 s), radial dissolve of tiles (9.67 s), hard cuts in the word section.
transitions.interpreted: Section turns are grown or wiped from the outgoing element; the word list is all cuts, each softened by the incoming word's smear.

depth_and_layering.observed: Mostly flat; one rotating point-cloud sphere-to-torus (9.7-11.2 s).

texture_and_effects.observed: Directional motion smear on fast words; no grain.

camera.observed: Locked frame; motion lives in the elements.

audio_and_sync.observed: Music-like bed, peak -1.8 dBFS, 5.2 onsets/s, tempo estimate 129 bpm (medium confidence); 80% of boundaries within 50 ms of an onset (chance 41%), 60% within 60 ms of the beat grid (chance 26%; analyzer 1.2).
audio_and_sync.interpreted: Cuts are locked to the music.

motifs.observed: The dot: it travels, becomes a full stop, seeds the bloom.

sound_design.observed: Integrated -13.1 LUFS, LRA 2.9 LU, true peak -1.2 dBTP. Tempo estimate 129 bpm (medium). 16 accents (64 a minute). Accents on cuts 0.40 against chance 0.19 (10 boundaries); onsets near boundaries 0.80 against 0.41, near the beat grid 0.60 against 0.26. No silences. Listen sheet: accents on the dot appearing (0.19 s), the starburst (1.00 s), the name card slamming and shattering (2.65, 3.34 s), dots reaching the end of their easing tracks (4.53, 5.22, 5.46 s), the tile wave (8.27 s) and each word card of the closing run on its cut (11.31, 11.54, 12.00, 12.26 s, 0.23-0.46 s apart).
sound_design.interpreted: In the word-beat run cuts and accents coincide (above chance); elsewhere the accents mark arrivals. One of the few references where cuts sit on accents.

narration.observed: 2 one-word phrases (1.05-2.88 s, 5.04-5.57 s) over the starburst and the easing chart; no speaker on any phrase frame; 1-2 word 'phrases' are dictation noise over the music. Verdict: none.

captions.observed: None; copy is full-frame heavy condensed words on colour cards with an accent full stop, an italic serif subtitle and tiny mono labels.

scenes.observed: Dark field: a burst of rays contracts into a small mark.
Iris bloom to orange; a wordmark assembles; letters collapse into dots.
Cream: dots on arcs with trails, an easing comparison chart, dots converge.
Blue: circle with satellites morphs to triangle with rays, then square.
Black: square subdivides into a tile pattern; orange wave spreads from the centre.
Dot grid becomes a rotating point cloud sphere, then torus.
Word cards on alternating fields with smears, falling letters, tiling.
Orange: ring and cursor, particle burst, brand lockup with underline.

moments.observed: The contracted mark becomes the seed of an iris bloom with a cream ring and orange core.
moments.interpreted: Transition motivated by the focal element.

moments.observed: Cut swaps figure and ground colours while the dot stays in place.
moments.interpreted: Continuity of position makes a hard cut feel smooth.

difficult: Point-cloud sphere-to-torus morph with depth (needs 3D projection; approximable with sampled SVG points)
